name: o12283

schema.title: Mapping
schema.description: A mapping used by Glue to extract findings from a security tool report

task_name.description: The name of the task (tool) the produce those findings

app_name.description: Path to the property in the report file that contains the target app name

key.description: The key in the JSON report to an array that contains findings

properties.description: The mapping between the items in the array and Glue's findings

description.description: The path on the array item to extract the description

detail.description: The path on the array item to extract the details

source.description: The path on the array item to extract the source

severity.description: The path on the array item to extract the severity

fingerprint.description: The path on the array item to extract the fingerprint

description:
The SnykScan task is set up to retrieve the target application name from the metadata.application.name field in the report. All vulnerability findings are taken from the vulnerabilities array, with each item mapped as follows: the issue title ( issue.title ) provides the description, the issue description ( issue.description ) supplies the detail, the issue source ( issue.source ) indicates the source, the issue severity level ( issue.severityLevel ) determines the severity, and the issue ID ( issue.id ) serves as the fingerprint. 

This configuration enables Glue to accurately extract and record each finding reported by SnykScan, ensuring the data aligns with our security analysis workflow.
